summaries.Romania: Romania faces critical energy crises at Cernavodá nuclear plant due to Danube drought, while political disputes over decarbonization law amendments threaten €5B in PNRR funding. Energy emergencies and infrastructure challenges dominate the national agenda alongside ongoing migration and political tensions.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with AI-driven clinical trials, drone prescription delivery, and expanded obesity treatment access, while regulatory frameworks evolve around digital health tools and preventive care technology deployment.
summaries.Tech: Apple navigates trade secret litigation with OpenAI while preparing major iPhone announcements; SpaceX revenue surges on AI compute deals; AI safety concerns mount as open-weight models approach frontier capabilities.

items.title: Directorul centralei de la Cernavodă: Dacă reușește operațiunea cu barjele scufundate în Dunăre, se asigură încă 2-3 zile de funcționare. Dacă operațiunea nu are succes, în 5-7 zile suntem nevoiți să oprim și Unitatea 2
items.snippet: Directorul centralei nucleare de la Cernavodă, Romeo Urjan, a declarat, marți seara, la Antena 3 CNN, că dacă reușește operațiunea cu barjele scufundate în Dunăre, se asigură încă 2-3 zile de funcționare a reactorului 2, în caz contrar fiind nevoiți peste, în 5-7 zile, să oprească și Unitatea 2. Rom
items.line: Cernavodá nuclear reactor faces imminent shutdown within 5-7 days if Danube water level doesn't recover, threatening Romania's energy security and PNRR commitments.

items.title: BREAKING | Președintele Nicușor Dan: Dacă Legea decarbonizării va fi adoptată cu amendamentele din comisii, voi uza de toate prerogativele constituționale, inclusiv solicitarea de reexaminare, pentru ca România să nu piardă banii din PNRR
items.snippet: Președintele Nicușor Dan a anunțat, marți seara, că, dacă Legea decarbonizării va fi adoptată cu amendamentele din comisii, va uza de toate prerogativele constituționale, inclusiv solicitarea de reexaminare, pentru ca România să nu piardă banii din PNRR. Este pentru prima dată în ultimele luni când
items.line: President Nicușor Dan threatens constitutional reexamination of decarbonization law amendments that could trigger €5B PNRR payment blocks and penalties.

items.title: QuantHealth Snags $45M to Simulate Clinical Trials Before Patients Ever Enroll
items.snippet: QuantHealth raised $45 million in Series B funding to expand its AI platform, which simulates clinical trials before they run and predicts patient outcomes for pharma companies. The startup is aiming to cut the industry’s 90% trial failure rate and speed up the timelines for effective drugs to reach
items.line: QuantHealth secures $45M to expand AI clinical trial simulations that could slash pharma's 90% drug failure rate and accelerate treatment timelines.

items.title: Apple moves for preliminary injunction in OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit
items.snippet: Apple has filed a request for a preliminary injunction in its ongoing trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI. Without a preliminary injunction, Apple says it will be “irreparably harmed” by the theft of its trade secrets.
items.line: Apple seeks preliminary injunction against OpenAI for alleged trade secret theft related to hardware development in escalating corporate litigation.

items.title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth
items.snippet: SpaceX doubled its revenue compared to last year, according to its first quarterly earnings since going public in June.
items.line: SpaceX doubles revenue on major Anthropic and Google compute deals, signaling AI infrastructure as dominant business driver alongside Starlink growth.

items.title: Avertisment al unui expert: „Verificați ce ați semnat și până când e valabil prețul”. Ce înseamnă criza energetică pentru facturile românilor
items.snippet: Creșterea facturilor la energie conduce la  „o consecință aproape inevitabilă”: scumpirea facturilor. Dar, pentru că nu se vor mări brusc, avem timp să ne adaptăm, explică specialiști cu care HotNews a discutat. România are în aceste zile de criză energetică unul dintre cele mai mari prețuri la ener
items.line: Energy price crisis threatens widespread consumer price increases across Romania as power costs surge during European energy shortage.

items.title: Cleveland Clinic, Zipline take flight with prescription drug drone delivery partnership
items.snippet: Cleveland Clinic and Zipline have taken to the skies with their drone-delivery partnership for prescription drugs. It marks the first long-term deployment of a prescription drug drone delivery by a health system, they said, with the first deliveries made last week in and around Beachwood.
items.line: Cleveland Clinic launches first long-term prescription drug delivery via drone partnership with Zipline, establishing new healthcare logistics model.

items.title: Function Health lands $450M in growth financing to scale tech-enabled preventive health
items.snippet: Function Health, a company that offers lab testing and body scans for early disease detection, landed $450 million in growth financing to scale its tech-enabled personalized preventive health services.
items.line: Function Health raises $450M for tech-enabled preventive health screening combining labs and body scans for early disease detection.

items.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
items.snippet: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.
items.line: SaferAI report warns open-weight GLM-5.2 matches frontier AI capabilities while lacking safety mitigations, raising governance gaps concerns.

items.title: Waymo opens up robotaxi service in Dallas to everyone
items.snippet: Waymo has dropped the waitlist for its robotaxi service in Dallas, the latest step in the company's bid to scale its self-driving technology across the United States, U.K., and Europe.
items.line: Waymo drops waitlist for Dallas robotaxi service, removing friction barrier as autonomous vehicles scale across major US markets.

items.title: Românii și criza migrației: Oameni care se simt salvați când ajung în Europa devin mai apoi nemulțumiți de modul european de muncă și de viață
items.snippet: Un tânăr bărbat din Maroc îngenunchează pe o plajă din UE, după ce și-a riscat viața ca să răzbească aici. Nu pot să scap de această imagine. items.title: Amae Health teams up with Google Health to integrate wearables data into SMI care
items.snippet: Amae’s long-term goal is to develop a predictive model that pulls on wearables and other data to measure disease state and progression and spot early warning signs of clinical decline.
items.line: Amae Health integrates wearables data with Google Health for real-time monitoring of serious mental illness progression and early warning detection.

items.title: Apple CarPlay expands to select pontoon boats with on-water navigation
items.snippet: CarPlay will soon move beyond the road, with Crest and Balise set to bring Apple’s in-car interface to the helm of select pontoon boats. Here are the details.
items.line: CarPlay expands beyond vehicles to pontoon boats via MasterCraft partnership, extending Apple's ecosystem into marine navigation.
